title: A small contribution
text: Could you explain your own contribution to the project?

options.text: I designed the evaluation protocol and implemented the analysis. My teammate built the interface. I can show the records for my part.
options.response: 你清楚地区分了个人贡献与团队成果，回答具体而可追问。

options.text: I did everything, because I was the leader.
options.response: 负责协调不等于完成所有工作，回答没有提供具体记录。

options.text: I helped with the project and learned a lot.
options.response: 表达自然，但贡献仍然抽象，可以补一个任务和结果。
